requirements.statement: Two features built in parallel on one project scaffolded by Ensemble merge into the base in either order with no conflict on any framework-written file

Every framework-written file shared across features is either untracked (gitignored) or union-merged; a newly scaffolded project (/init-project) and an existing project refreshed or rebased (--refresh, /rebase-project) both receive the ignore lines and union lines
An existing project that already tracks .trd-state/current.json stops tracking it, and the file stays on disk
isRecordFile in packages/core/lib/record-files.js stays the one definition of a record file; every union-merged path is a record file by that definition

tasks.description: Stop the non-strict version stamp writing ensemble.refreshed_at; add templates/gitignore-framework.txt; add two union lines to templates/gitattributes-additions.txt; add ensure_gitignore() to scaffold-project.sh (append missing lines, untrack tracked listed paths via git rm --cached in a work tree); call it beside both ensure_gitattributes calls; add strict --git-files mode; add the two union lines to this repo's .gitattributes. Dependencies: none. Acceptance: scaffold writes all four ignore lines and three union lines; --refresh and --git-files add them once and are idempotent; current.json untracked but kept on disk; --refresh never changes the git index; refreshed_at unchanged while version updated; --stamp-version still writes refreshed_at; exits 0 outside git.

Update /rebase-project (new always-run step calling scaffold-project.sh --git-files, fix stale .gitignore line, note 4.8 still writes refreshed_at), /init-project Step 11 and line ~618, and the gitignore-additions.txt comment block. Keep three byte-identical copies of each command in step. Dependencies: FIX-001. Acceptance: rebase-project.md names --git-files in an always-run step; gitignore-additions.txt no longer says current.json should be committed; three copies identical; scaffold-project.test.sh and runtime-integrity.test.sh pass.

Tests: extend scaffold-project.test.sh (ignore lines on scaffold/refresh/--git-files, idempotent, untrack keeps file); new BATS test/integration/tests/parallel-feature-merge.test.sh (two feature branches merged A-then-B and B-then-A with zero conflicts, plus a conflicting control); Jest assertion in record-files.test.js that every gitattributes-additions.txt path satisfies isRecordFile. Dependencies: FIX-001. Acceptance: BATS passes both orders; control conflicts; Jest assertion passes and fails if a non-record path is added.

could_not_verify: Whether GitHub's server-side pull-request merge honours merge=union from .gitattributes is not established. It does not affect /ship-build, which merges the base in locally first, and the ignore lines do not depend on it.

Rollout: a project that tracked current.json before this change is clean only once the untracking is committed on its base branch; until then a feature branch that rebased and one that did not can still meet a modify/delete on that file. No test covers that transitional state.
